1.name: TEXT_REGROC2JAQUOINIE_00671_JAQUOINIE_000_001
1.description: I am a soldier in the service of Lord Aurvael de Haillenarte. If you seek my master, he is presently in the Firmament for a new undertaking.
1.translation_description: Sono un soldato al servizio di Lord Aurvael de Haillenarte. Se cerchi il mio signore, si trova al Firmamento per una nuova impresa.

2.name: TEXT_REGROC2JAQUOINIE_00671_JAQUOINIE_000_002
2.description: However, I should be pleased to assist you with any lockboxes you may possess, as well as trade with you for your sky pirate spoils.
2.translation_description: Sarò lieto di aiutarti con tutti i forzieri che possiedi e di scambiare con te il tuo bottino dei Pirati del Cielo.

3.name: TEXT_REGROC2JAQUOINIE_00671_JAQUOINIE_000_003
3.description: Owing to recent developments, these items are not as common as they once were, but should you chance to acquire them, please feel free to come to me.
3.translation_description: A causa dei recenti sviluppi, questi oggetti sono meno comuni di un tempo, ma se dovessi riuscire a procurartene, passa pure da me.
